story: As a maintainer, I can distinguish original upstream TCP conformance evidence from matched native throughput evidence without treating missing capabilities or harness failures as passes.

denied_tags.needs:debug: Implementation-specific DEBUG/refcount assertions are not a portable wire contract.
denied_tags.needs:repl: Replication is unimplemented; this job covers one standalone TCP endpoint.
denied_tags.slow: Bounded initial PR scope; large randomized/stress blocks need a separate capacity run.

compatibility.known_candidate_blocker: Rillcache currently lacks FLUSHALL/FUNCTION/CONFIG. Unchanged start_server external setup can stop before any assertions. This is a failing prerequisite-blocked result, never a compatibility pass. No protocol proxy or test patch supplies missing commands.

option_limits.--singledb: SELECT and multidatabase assertions tagged singledb:skip are automatically excluded in BOTH control and candidate.
option_limits.--ignore-encoding: Object encodings and some memory-layout assertions are not portable; upstream assert_encoding is disabled in BOTH runs.
option_limits.--ignore-digest: Upstream implementation DEBUG digest checks are disabled in BOTH runs; this is not full keyspace equivalence.
option_limits.--durable: Continue after assertion/command exceptions where upstream permits; setup/outside-test exceptions can still abort the unit.
option_limits.external mode: Upstream automatically skips external:skip blocks (process restarts, persistence, multiple servers). Conditions can omit tests without emitting skip events.

excluded_units.reason: Upstream marks its main protocol block external:skip; zero executed tests must not appear green.
C module/API and implementation-specific tests are not applicable to the Rust TCP candidate.
Cluster/multinode topology is unimplemented and outside the single-endpoint contract.
Persistence, replication, restart/upgrade and other multi-instance integration behavior is outside this bounded initial scope.
Not selected in the initial strings/integer/keyspace cohort. No coverage or support claim; complete pinned-source unit inventory is emitted per run.

performance.limits: Loopback RESP2, keepalive, 16 clients, fixed 1-worker candidate/native main execution, no auth/TLS/persistence/eviction, libc native allocators. Same runner and disjoint server/client CPU affinity. Native background threads and candidate control thread still exist. No cluster, durable, multi-type, realistic mixed-load, scaling or production-equivalence claim. 64-byte SET/GET values, uniform random 1024-key namespace; GET-miss intentionally empty. Latency is upstream generator request/pipeline latency, NOT an independently validated per-command HDR histogram.
